scope: Local itinerary persistence from PlanResult into immutable snapshot

contracts.truth_boundary: Trip snapshot is immutable once saved; does not re-fetch or alter canonical routes
contracts.fare_semantics: hopFare is strictly null across all saved stops (truth invariant)
contracts.stop_sequence_ordering: sortedStops evaluates dayNumber ascending, then stopSequence ascending
contracts.cascade_deletion: Deleting saved_trips record cascades deletion to saved_trip_stops and trip_progress

storage_engines.android: Room SQLite (saved_trips, saved_trip_stops with ForeignKey CASCADE)

operations_verified.save_plan_action: PlanItineraryView / itineraryResultView saves generated itinerary to local database
operations_verified.save_trip_states: UNSAVED -> SAVING -> SAVED lifecycle feedback rendered accurately
operations_verified.title_formatting: Automatic fallback title: '<days>-Day <hub> Itinerary' if custom title omitted
operations_verified.constraints_snapshot: JSON payload captures days, pace, startHub, lowWalking, publicTransportPreferred, interests
operations_verified.ai_explanation_persisted: Grounded AI explanation stored verbatim for offline consultation
